name: Red-berried Elder
desc: Red-berried Elder (Sambucus racemosa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Sambucus racemosa, also known as red-berried elder or red elderberry, is a species of shrub in the moschatel family Viburnaceae. It is native across much of the Northern Hemisphere.
